name: ComboBox
summary: Filters and selects from a collection of options.

obligations: Expose input, expanded state, active option, and collection relations.

behavior: Typeahead filtering and arrow-key collection navigation are supported.
Controlled and uncontrolled text values are supported.
The input text and the selected option are separate: value and defaultValue hold the text, and selectedId and defaultSelectedId hold the option's id.
onChange reports the text, and onSelect reports the chosen item.
When only the text is controlled, choosing an option calls onChange with the option's label.
When both the text and the selected id are controlled, choosing an option does not update the text, so the application sets it, usually to the option's label.
Emptying the input clears the selection without calling onSelect, so a controlled selectedId stays until the application changes it.
Interactive control sizes use the shared sm, md, and lg targets; md is the default.
Named forms submit the selected item id, not item.value.
errorMessage is shown only while the field is invalid, through the invalid prop or failed validation, and replaces the default message; it never makes the field invalid by itself.
items is the full option set, so pass every option rather than a pre-filtered list.
The component filters items as the user types with a case- and accent-insensitive contains match on each item's text.
accessibility: Expose input, expanded state, active option, and collection relations.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
